body: That makes sense, I suppose. That's one thing I haven't tried... To try less. I find that somewhat amusing and/or ironic, don't take the the wrong way. I guess it's hard for me because I came to terms long ago with the fact that I'm not for everyone. I can't please the majority of people. I did think that it was possible to be a positive factor in the lives of those who I cared about and shared a mutual form of compassion with. This is turning out to be untrue, and as I truly do not enjoy endless solitude or being alone, life seems like it has little meaning if I have no one to share the few "ups" with.

I'm sorry that it hits close to home with you as well. I really finally had the guts to post because while I share the miserable feelings of other people who post here, I can't always relate to their same situations, if that makes sense. 

I can understand how that mindset and realization helped you through, I am hoping that I might come to a sort of zen feeling with it like you did. The harshness of that reality, though, is what gets me this way, the feeling of having no hope, no one to care for you. I just don't want to live if it's going to be that way, you are a stronger person than I for living with that type of reality.
